digest.component_or_area: CLI-served author guides and commit-trailer discovery
propositions: Clients using rebar CLI without a repository checkout encounter dangling internal cross-references in packaged author guides because links use consumer-relative paths that do not resolve offline.

The required rebar-ticket commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT) lacks a first-class CLI home and is only discoverable via rebar verify-commit-ticket help, leaving it undiscoverable for repo-less clients.

Packaged author guides must repoint all internal references to either sibling guides via rebar explain <topic> or external repo documentation via https://github.com/navapbc/rebar hosted URLs to ensure offline resolution.

A new commit-ticket-trailer.md packaged guide must be registered in AUTHOR_GUIDES registry and served by rebar explain commit-trailer, with content quoting EXPECTED_FORMAT verbatim and linking only via allowed schemes.

Link-resolution guard tests must prevent regression by asserting no packaged guide contains consumer-relative markdown link targets, bare repo paths, or references to unregistered rebar explain topics.
The MCP explain_criterion tool docstring and wheel packaging must enumerate all registered author guides dynamically to keep guide discovery synchronized with the registry.
